vetSays.line: 🛡️ Vincent, the person in their 60s, with a farmer's tan, José and the person in their 40s met them at the door — 4 put down. Vincent, the person in their 60s, with a farmer's tan, José, the person in their 40s are hurt.
🛡️ Sofia, Adrián, Elijah and Giulia met them at the door — 4 put down. Sofia, Adrián, Elijah, Giulia are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Vincent strikes the Elder Choir Toad.
The Elder Choir Toad falls.
📺 Vincent brought down Elder Choir Toad, Choir Toad, Choir Toad, Choir Toad. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sofia, Adrián, Elijah and Giulia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Sofia, Elijah, Giulia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vincent just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vincent just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Sofia was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Desmond taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Desmond is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Big-Eyes shifts, seeking a clear lane.
The Elder Big-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Big-Eyes!
📺 You brought down Elder Big-Eyes. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder Big-Eyes.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Vincent strikes the Scarred The Ugly Beast.
The Scarred The Ugly Beast falls.
📺 Vincent brought down Scarred The Ugly Beast. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Giulia just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Theo just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
